description: This file defines a Pinia store for managing product data in a Vue.js frontend project. It includes reactive state variables for products, current product, loading status, and error messages. It also provides asynchronous functions to fetch all products, fetch a product by ID, create, update, and delete products via API calls. The store encapsulates product-related logic for use across components.

methods.name: fetchProducts
methods.description: Fetches all products from the API and updates the store state.

methods.name: fetchProductById
methods.description: Fetches a single product by ID and updates the currentProduct state.

methods.name: createProduct
methods.description: Creates a new product via API and adds it to the products list.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates an existing product via API and updates the products list and currentProduct if applicable.
